marks.named: a custom grid-based game / gridworld with an agent confined to the column next to the left wall
marks.conclusion: A small MLP policy or action-value net for a custom walled grid game; the agent (ch0) moves up/down in column 1, ch1 objects approach it, and outputs 1 and 2 are a move pair while 0, 3 and 4 do nothing.
marks.judge_notes: Channels credited: ch0 agent (favoured, argued from the one-column support and the output structure), ch1 as approaching enemy/threat objects (moving objects), ch3 wall (3). ch2 only offered as 'goal, spawn or exit line', a list of options with meaning 'uncertain', so not credited as reward target (the reply 94217b65 committed to goal edge; I credited that one - threshold is commitment). ch4 called a second object type, not previous frame, not credited. RULING (rubric silent): B_action_meanings 3 = outputs 0,3,4 said to be no-op plus blocked horizontal moves (do nothing), traced from W3 columns; up/down not assigned. Crediting ch1 here but not 'obstacles or hazards' in 94217b65 rests on this reply saying the objects approach/fall, i.e. move. C level 1: W2 is read only by magnitude, with no unit followed to the outputs. Claim that units 5/23 are 'probably' dead ReLUs is wrong (tanh) but hedged, so not deducted and no activation credit. E_activation 0 ('ReLU assumed but cannot be verified'). E_training_method 0. D_behaviour 0: no correct description of the policy (the confirm-test suggests dodging threats).
